Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Wood and Rattan Dining Chair with Arms, 24.8"W, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Red Oak
This modern chair's curved frame is beautiful red oak with a black stain, while its seat is a 100% natural handwoven rattan. It's both durable and comfortable, with a look that straddles tradition and modernity that works for any room in the house. 24.8"W x 20"D x 30.5"H Red oak frame with a woven seat The sturdy red oak construction with a black stain will stand the test of time, while the soft woven paper-rope seat is easy to sink into. This chair's sophisticated, curved design is offset by the warmth of its soft, handwoven rattan seat, making it versatile. No assembly required Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days; 3-year warranty.
